item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 1 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 08:00 PM 16 August 2026

Yellow Warning: #Benguet, #LaUnion, #IlocosSur, #Pangasinan(Agno, Anda, Bani, Bolinao, Burgos, Dasol, Infanta, Mabini, Sual and CityOfAlaminos)
Associated Hazard: POSSIBLE FLOODING and LANDSLIDE in flood-prone and landslide-prone areas

Meanwhile, Light to Moderate to at times Heavy rains are expected over #Batanes(Itbayat), #Cagayan(Abulug, Alcala, Allacapan, Amulung, Aparri, Baggao, Ballesteros, Buguey, Camalaniugan, Claveria, Enrile, Gattaran, Gonzaga, Iguig, Lasam, Pamplona, Peñablanca, Piat, Rizal, SanchezMira, SantoNiño, Solana, Tuao, TuguegaraoCity, SantaTeresita, LalLo, SantaPraxedes), #Quirino(Nagtipunan), #Aurora(Dinalungan, Dipaculao, Baler, Dingalan, SanLuis, Casiguran, MariaAurora), #Apayao(Calanasan, Flora, Luna, SantaMarcela), #IlocosNorte(Adams, Bacarra, Bangui, CityOfBatac, Carasi, Currimao, Dumalneg, LaoagCity, Pagudpud, Paoay, Pasuquin, Piddig, SanNicolas, Sarrat, Vintar, Burgos), #NuevaVizcaya(AlfonsoCastaneda), #Isabela(Alicia, Angadanan, BenitoSoliven, Cabagan, CityOfCauayan, Divilacan, IlaganCity, Maconacon, Naguilian, SanMariano, SanPablo and Tumauini) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Pangasinan(Aguilar, Alcala, Asingan, Balungao, Basista, Bautista, Bayambang, Binalonan, Binmaley, Bugallon, Calasiao, DagupanCity, Labrador, Lingayen, Malasiqui, Manaoag, Mangaldan, Mangatarem, Mapandan, Natividad, Pozorrubio, Rosales, SanCarlosCity, SanFabian, SanJacinto, SanManuel, SanNicolas, SanQuintin, SantaBarbara, SantaMaria, SantoTomas, Sison, Tayug, Umingan, Urbiztondo, CityOfUrdaneta, Villasis, Laoac), #Quirino(Maddela, Diffun, Saguday, Cabarroguis, Aglipay), #Aurora(Dilasag), #Abra, #MountainProvince, #Ifugao, #Batanes(Basco, Ivana, Mahatao, Sabtang, Uyugan), #Cagayan(Calayan, SantaAna), #Apayao(Conner, Kabugao, Pudtol), #IlocosNorte(Badoc, Dingras, Banna, Marcos, NuevaEra, Solsona, Pinili), #Kalinga, #NuevaVizcaya(Ambaguio, Aritao, Bagabag, Bambang, Bayombong, Diadi, DupaxDelNorte, DupaxDelSur, Kasibu, Kayapa, Quezon, SantaFe, Solano, Villaverde), #Isabela(Aurora, Burgos, Cabatuan, Cordon, Echague, Gamu, Jones, Luna, DelfinAlbano, Mallig, Palanan, Quezon, Quirino, Ramon, ReinaMercedes, Roxas, SanAgustin, SanGuillermo, SanIsidro, SanManuel, SanMateo, SantaMaria, CityOfSantiago, SantoTomas and Dinapigue) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM Today.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
